sourceEvidence.title: Project Manager, Engineering
sourceEvidence.quote:
**Required Qualifications/Skills:**
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial or a related field)
* Minimum 3-year experience with Manufacturing process environment
* Preventive maintenance inspections & audits
* AutoCad software and MS Office: Excel, Word, and Power Point
* Coordinate / follow-up projects including CAD drawings, technical guidance for parts, equipment, and suppliers
* Ability to work in a faced pace environment
* Ability to work in a noisy, wet, and cold environment of 36°F
* Availability to work on weekend when the project installation requires
* Strong interpersonal and communication skill (oral and written)
* Food manufacturing experience
